items.text: Motif presumably bonded Ishnah, one of the first members of the Unseen Court, after the Battle of Thaylen Field. By around Vev 1175, Ishnah could manifest him as a Shardblade. Like the other Cryptics, he used the name "Pattern" before grudgingly choosing a different name to help humans tell them apart.

Shallan chose Ishnah and Motif for the coalition's diplomatic mission to Lasting Integrity. Travelling through the Cognitive Realm, Motif was usually seen with his fellow Cryptics Mosaic, Ornament and Pattern, and their odd behaviour sometimes unnerved their human companions.

appearance.text: In the Physical Realm, Motif usually appears as patterns on a spherical ornament at the end of a hairspike in Ishnah's braids, and he is smaller than Pattern. In the Cognitive Realm he looks like a typical Cryptic: a tall humanoid in stiff robes, with shifting symbols for a head.

personality.text: Motif speaks Alethi poorly and prefers the Cryptic language. Like other Cryptics, he has little grasp of human behaviour or mannerisms, and lies thrill him.
